_meta.note: Progressive data collection & graceful degradation — the unified model for what happens when an input is MISSING, STALE, DECAYED, or INVALID across every input type (lab / wearable / clinical markers, PRO & lifestyle questions, wearable baselines, user goals). When real data is absent the system substitutes a COHORT statistic (age×sex×life-stage median/mean, D33) so scoring stays continuous, lowers Accuracy, widens the forecast, exposes the substitution in the companion vector, and nudges the user to fill the gap. Illustrative; engine wiring (extend assets/engine.js imputation to all channels + invalid gate) is the implementation step. Re-verify (README §5.6).
_meta.safety_invariant: A COHORT-SUBSTITUTED value is informational-only. It MAY lower a score and widen uncertainty, but it can NEVER (a) raise Confidence or Accuracy, (b) trigger a red/critical pillar floor (R_crit), or (c) fire a clinical Early-warning Advisory/Alert. Only a REAL, in-date, VALID measurement can do those. This extends D22 (trust tiers) and preserves the critical-marker gate, which already requires state=present with a real value.
_meta.design: cohort-fill for CONTINUITY, never for confidence · accuracy & forecast degrade monotonically with missingness/staleness/cohort-fill · every gap raises a data-completeness nudge (data-completeness-nudges.json).

data_states.present: real, in-date, valid measurement — full weight & confidence (q_source).
data_states.stale: real but older than the metric's fresh-within SLA — confidence decays q_source·exp(−Δt/τ); value blends toward neutral as it ages.
data_states.decayed: stale beyond stale_dt_days — effectively non-informative; treated as missing for the centre but kept for provenance.
data_states.invalid: fails the plausibility gate (out-of-physiological-range / implausible) — REJECTED to quarantine, then treated as missing (cohort-substituted), never allowed to saturate the risk function.
data_states.missing: no usable value — cohort statistic substituted at low confidence (per input type below).

lab_marker.label: Lab biomarker (ApoB, HbA1c, eGFR…)
lab_marker.fallback: age×sex×life-stage cohort median F⁻¹(0.5) (D33); source flag = literature_fallback
lab_marker.accuracy_effect: counts toward cohort-fill fraction → lowers Accuracy
lab_marker.safety: informational; can't trigger critical (gate requires a present real value)

wearable_marker.label: Wearable metric (RHR, HRV, SpO₂, steps…)
wearable_marker.fallback: personal baseline prior if one exists (baseline pipeline cold_start), else age×sex cohort median + device-tier prior
wearable_marker.safety: consumer/inferential tier (D22) can't set red/critical anyway; cohort-fill stays informational

clinical_marker.label: Clinical device value (home BP, waist, CGM TIR, ODI)
clinical_marker.fallback: age×sex×life-stage cohort median; source = literature_fallback; shown as 'estimated — please measure'
clinical_marker.confidence: q_impute_clinical ≈ 0.15 (lowest — we really want the real reading)
clinical_marker.safety: a cohort-filled clinical value NEVER triggers red/critical/alert — only a real measurement can flag hypertension/apnea etc.

pro_question.label: PRO / lifestyle question (PHQ, GAD, ISI, AUDIT-C, diet, IPAQ)
pro_question.fallback: cohort modal/median response for age×sex×life-stage (+ persona prior) when unanswered
pro_question.today: GAP — no cohort default for unanswered questions (coverage-audit F11)
pro_question.safety: a cohort-default PRO can't fire a mental-health Advisory/Alert (requires a real answer)

wearable_baseline.label: Personal wearable baseline (μ/σ per metric)
wearable_baseline.fallback: age×sex×life-stage cohort prior μ/σ (D33); 'provisional' until n_effective ≥ min-history; shrinks to personal as data accrues
wearable_baseline.safety: a provisional baseline can't fire a deviation Alert until enough personal history (boiling-frog/cold-start guards)

user_goal.label: User goal (per pillar)
user_goal.fallback: persona/archetype default goal seeded at onboarding (goals.json applicability), marked 'suggested'
user_goal.today: GAP — defaults implicit via applicability, no explicit seed step
user_goal.safety: a defaulted goal is a suggestion, never a commitment or a clinical target

accuracy_model.def: Accuracy A_k = Confidence_k · Sufficiency_k · (1 − λ·cohortFillFraction_k), bounded [0,1], reported as a %.
accuracy_model.terms: Confidence = source quality × freshness (q·exp(−Δt/τ)); Sufficiency = fresh-patient-data fraction; cohortFillFraction = share of the pillar's weight currently met by cohort substitution; λ ≈ 0.5 (expert-prior).
accuracy_model.distinct_from: Confidence = is present data trustworthy? Sufficiency = is data present? Accuracy = the combined, cohort-penalised headline the user sees ('reported with lower accuracy').
accuracy_model.report: Accuracy shown beside the score and per pillar; drops as data goes missing/stale or is cohort-filled.

forecast_model.def: Trajectory forecast widens with uncertainty: point days-to-threshold T̂ from the robust slope; half-width H = k · (σ_t / A) · √(horizon), where σ_t = pillar Volatility (companion #8) and A = Accuracy. Shown as a CONE, not a line.
forecast_model.behaviour: high accuracy → tight cone (T̂ ± 3d); low accuracy / high volatility / heavy cohort-fill → wide cone (T̂ ± 15d) or 'forecast withheld' when A < a floor.
forecast_model.withhold: below an accuracy floor the forecast is shown as a range only or suppressed with 'need more data', never a confident point.

invalid_handling.detect: per-marker plausibility gate (min/max from wearable-metrics.json / range-variations) — e.g. HR>220, SpO₂<70, negative durations
invalid_handling.action: REJECT → quarantine-with-context → treat the marker as missing → cohort-substitute + flag; never let an implausible value saturate the continuous risk function
invalid_handling.gap: the scoring engine has no INVALID state today (only missing/stale) — invalid values currently saturate; this model adds the gate

companion_extension.note: Three additions so the companion vector exposes degradation (extends the 10 meta-dims, Doc 05 §4):

dims.name: Cohort-fill %
dims.def: share of the score/pillar currently met by cohort substitution vs real patient data; 0% = fully personal, 100% = fully cohort

dims.name: Accuracy
dims.def: A_k = Cf·Su·(1−λ·CohortFill) — the cohort-penalised headline accuracy

dims.name: Forecast band
dims.def: half-width of the days-to-threshold cone = k·(Volatility/Accuracy)·√horizon
dims.shows: '~21±12 days to yellow' or 'forecast needs more data'
